title: Sometimes the cart carries the boat
odia:
କେତେ ବେଳେ ସଗଡ଼ ଉପରେ ନାଆ
କେତେ ବେଳେ ନାଆ ଉପରେ ସଗଡ଼
literal_meaning: Sometimes the boat is on the cart; sometimes the cart is on the boat.
meaning_odia: ସମୟ ସହ ଅବସ୍ଥା ଓ ଭାଗ୍ୟ ବଦଳେ। କେବେ ଶଗଡ଼ ନାଆକୁ ବୋହେ, କେବେ ନାଆ ଶଗଡ଼କୁ ବୋହେ—ଏହି ଓଲଟା ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିର ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି।
explanation: The same two objects exchange positions: what carries at one time is carried at another. The inspected gloss reads this as changing fortune and reversed circumstances. A present advantage or dependence need not remain fixed.
usage_example: A neighbour who once helped a family through a difficult period later needs that family’s help. Someone recalls the cart and boat as their roles change. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: Both cart and boat are means of carrying things, yet each becomes the other’s load in turn. Reversing their order in the second line makes the change in circumstances visible and easy to remember.

odia_summary: ଯିଏ ଆଜି ବୋହୁଛି, ସେ ଆଉ କେବେ ବୁହା ହୋଇପାରେ।
english_summary: Circumstances change, and the carrier can become the carried.
